title.en: Attractive styling with occasional service inconsistencies

text.en: Most dog owners are delighted with beautiful haircut finishes, pleasant fragrances, and careful nail clipping. Many clients praise groomer Andy for show-quality coats on long-standing canine regulars. However, a minority reported hygiene issues including damp fur on collection, and one client experienced post-grooming health irritation.

Clients regularly commend Andy and the salon staff for their welcoming attitude and dedicated customer service. Reviewers note that groomers listen attentively to styling requests and handle elderly or fearful dogs with genuine patience. Longtime customers express deep appreciation for the team's reliable and accommodating service.

Pet parents highlight the staff's compassionate handling of nervous rescue pets, young puppies, and senior dogs with medical conditions. Reviewers appreciate that animals enter the salon happily and remain calm throughout the grooming routine. Owners feel confident leaving anxious pets in the hands of experienced animal handlers.

q.en: Does Paws Solutions cater to nervous or anxious dogs?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently note that groomers are patient and accommodate nervous or reactive dogs in a reassuring manner.

q.en: Are puppy introductory grooming sessions available?

a.en: Yes, the salon offers gentle puppy pamper sessions to help young dogs become accustomed to grooming.

q.en: Are pricing details clarified before grooming appointments?

a.en: Some reviewers report unexpected price adjustments upon payment, recommending confirming current rates when booking.

q.en: What services are included in standard grooming packages?

a.en: Full grooms typically include bathing, coat trimming, hygiene clipping, and careful nail maintenance.
